newsitem.title: USA: Cruise Holdings acquires lines from Viad.
newsitem.headline: Cruise Holdings acquires lines from Viad.

text.p: Viad Corp, the parent of Premier Cruise Lines, said Tuesday it agreed to sell its family cruise line to Cruise Holdings Ltd of Miami.
Cruise Holdings is the owner of Dolphin Cruise Lines and Seawind Cruise Lines.
Viad had said it wanted to exit the cruise business as part of a corporatewide restructuring that would let it concentrate on core businesses.
The company said Premier Cruise Lines will continue to operate as the Big Red Boat and the 1,800-passenger Oceanic will continue to sail the Bahamas.
Completion of the sale is expected on governmental approval.
